Team — forwarding Zendesk renewal quote we just received. Key dates: renewal on 2025-09-15. Options per Sam: 12-month renewal (5% off) or 6-month extension.

Context: CS usage has grown ~8% this year; we are also evaluating Intercom for messaging + Gainsight for Success. I need a recommendation and a short decision timeline from each function:
- Monica (CS): operational risk, migration effort, feature gaps.
- Markus (Finance): TCO and near-term budget impact.
- Laura (Legal): any contract red flags; if short extension is safer from a legal POV.

Proposed plan: quick sync next Tue (30 min) to decide whether to: renew Zendesk for 12 months, extend 6 months, or begin an accelerated RFP for Intercom+Gainsight. Please reply with availability and a one-paragraph assessment by EOD Mon.

Thanks,
Connor
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 04 Aug 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Zendesk renewal — quote & options

Quick read from CS perspective:
- Zendesk is stable for ticketing but we've hit limits on conversational routing and channels; our engineers have added workarounds.
- Intercom offers better chat-first flows and targeted Messenger experiences that match product roadmap; migration estimate: 8–12 weeks for core support flows (tickets + chat).
- Gainsight would be additive for high-touch success workflows (health scores, playbooks) — not a 1:1 replacement for Zendesk.

I've attached a short comparison I put together (seat costs, migration estimate, integrations). My preference: negotiate a 6-month extension with Zendesk while we run a parallel PoC with Intercom (reduce risk, allow proper data migration).

Attachment: Support_Success_Tooling_Comparison.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)

Monica
Head of Customer Success

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Zendesk renewal — quote & options

Thanks — from Finance: we have limited headroom in Q4; a full 12-month renewal at list will be painful to budget. Ask: can we get a 6-month extension or a month-to-month addendum while we evaluate alternatives? If Zendesk will not flex, a migration needs to show >=20% annual TCO improvement to be compelling.

Also please include expected migration costs (engineering hours, data migration, consultancy), and any temporary overlap expenses if we run both systems for a month or two.

Markus
Director, Finance Operations

- Typical timeline & cost to migrate 3 years of ticket history (approx. 200k tickets).
- Any recommended partners for data migration and integration with our SSO/KMS setup.

Attachment referenced: Intercom_RFI.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

Connor

Hi Connor — thanks for the details.

Prelim numbers (ballpark): 60 seats + onboarding = ~$140k ARR; migration services typically $18k–$35k depending on transform work. We have a partner (Brightpath Integrations) who does 60–90 day migrations for similar volume. Intercom supports SAML SSO and can work with your KMS for key management — would need a short security questionnaire.

Schedule: here's a demo slot: https://cal.com/intercom/demo/connor-30m. I can send an official quote after a quick scoping call.

Related: We can provide a 3-month credit for a short-term overlap if you sign by 2025-09-01 to help with migration costs.

Best,
Natalie Chen
Enterprise Sales, Intercom
